purpose: A coordinated painted botanical family derived from Sertum's approved classical Marian garden.

rounds.prompt: Create a single exquisite painted botanical asset for Sertum Rosarum, a Catholic rosary app. Use the supplied Marian garden ONLY as the reference for the exact traditional painted botanical style, rose species, pigment texture and palette. Do not depict Mary, architecture, a garden, a whole scene, lettering or interface. The asset is ONE fully open old garden rose viewed almost straight from above, a clear rounded many-petaled rosette with a gently cupped heart, delicate nested spiral of petals, softly scalloped outer petals, warm dusty blush pink and rosewood in the heart, warm pale peach-cream highlights, beautifully restrained painterly shading, subtle tempera/watercolor brush texture. Match the lovely pink roses in the reference. Luminous, graceful, natural, elegant sacred-garden character. Designed to work both as a large 70dp emblem and a tiny 20–28dp prayer bead: use coherent broad petal shapes, a clear silhouette and a distinct central whorl, without fragile outlines or excessive speckling. The flower is completely stemless and leafless so it can be repeated along a rosary and assembled into a crown. Absolutely no yellow daisy center, no stamens dot, no five-petal clipart geometry, no photographic harshness, no thick outline, no 3D render. Center the single rose in a square canvas with a small even 8 percent transparent margin around the entire flower. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY outside the petal silhouette, no black matte, paper rectangle, opaque background, shadow card, border, detached petals, text, logos or watermark. One finished high-resolution square transparent rose asset.

Create ONE matching CLOSED ROSEBUD asset in the exact hand-painted botanical language and warm blush/sage palette of the supplied open rose and Marian garden. This is a small prayer bead awaiting its bloom. One upright, gracefully cupped, unopened old garden rosebud, warm dusty blush pink with a subtle peach highlight and a delicate seam where the petals curl together, framed at its base by five slender pointed muted sage sepals. A very short fine stem below and only TWO small graceful sage-green rose leaves, one leaning left and one right; keep the compact silhouette balanced, with natural asymmetry and space around it. No long branch or extra buds. Beautiful traditional tempera/watercolor botanical illustration, luminous, soft, quiet, tender and refined, matching the naturalistic painted flowers in the reference. Use coherent broad shapes and restrained fine texture so it remains distinct and legible at 16–22dp tall; no fuzzy over-detailed miniature. The closed bud itself should remain the dominant form. Center the complete small sprig on a square transparent canvas, inset at least 10 percent on every side. The bud and sepals occupy about 65 percent of canvas height, the short stem does not extend far below them, compact overall form. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY around and between the entire plant, no paper, black matte, white background, border, typography, logo, interface, watercolor background wash or shadow. No geometric teardrop clipart, cartoon or 3D. Deliver one exquisite high-resolution square transparent bud asset.

Create one standalone painted ROSE LEAF asset matching the traditional botanical painting of the supplied Marian garden. This will be repeated as tiny foliage along a prayer stem and in a woven crown of roses. One gracefully tapered sage-green rose leaf with gently serrated edges, an elegant slight bend, a softly visible central vein and just a few delicate branching veins. The leaf points upward and slightly to the right, with a tiny short petiole extending downward from its base. The whole leaf is a slender natural oval/lance form, about twice as tall as it is wide; subtly asymmetrical. Color is muted eucalyptus/sage, warm olive in the recesses, a softly silver-sage highlighted edge. Traditional naturalistic tempera and watercolor botanical brushwork, luminous matte paint, delicate and refined rather than a photographic cutout. Broad clear masses that remain lovely at 9–18dp tall. Keep the leaf completely alone: no flowers, buds, branches, additional leaves, frame or surrounding garden. Center it in a square canvas with at least 12 percent empty transparent margin on all sides. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY outside the silhouette, no black matte, paper, white background, watercolor wash, shadow, lettering or watermark. No vector clipart, thick outlines or 3D. Deliver one exquisite high-resolution square transparent leaf asset.

Create a matching IVORY / CHAMPAGNE edition of the supplied single open painted rose. Preserve exactly the rose species, rounded silhouette, gentle cupped center, layered spiral of many natural petals, delicate painterly texture, scale, front/top viewpoint and transparent square framing. Change only the petal color: warm ivory and buttercream outer petals with soft champagne-gold folds and a gentle warm honey-ochre shadow in the heart, luminous cream highlights, beautifully restrained shading, no pure white clipping and no flat yellow center. It should feel like the cream roses in the supplied Marian garden, in the same elegant traditional tempera/watercolor style as its blush companion. This asset will mark the five mysteries within a fifty-rose crown and must remain recognizable at a tiny display size. Keep broad coherent petal masses and a clearly readable central whorl. One single stemless, leafless rose, no buds, stamens dot, branches, wreath or additional flowers. Center within the same square canvas, with safe transparent margin all around. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY outside the rose, no black matte, white paper, opaque background, cast shadow, frame, text, logos, interface, glitter or 3D. Deliver one exquisite high-resolution transparent ivory rose.
